title: pi-serena-lsp Tool Contracts
description: Shared JSON contract defining parameters for all Serena LSP tools exposed to the Pi coding agent. This file is the single source of truth for parameter types, required fields, and descriptions across the TypeScript and Python sides.

get_type.description: Resolve a name_path to its defining type symbol (interface, class, type alias, etc.) and return compact symbol information.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path to resolve to a type definition.

relative_path.description: Optional path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root, to scope the search.

get_symbols_overview.description: Get a Serena top-level symbol overview for a source file.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

find_symbol.description: Search Serena's LSP symbol index by exact name path.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path to search for. Exact match only.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of symbol matches to return. -1 means unlimited.

find_referencing_symbols.description: Find symbols that reference a given Serena symbol.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

find_implementations.description: Find implementations for a symbol using Serena's LSP backend when the active language server supports it.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

rename_symbol.description: Rename a symbol throughout the project using Serena's LSP refactoring.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

new_name.description: New symbol name. The language server may reject rename if the workspace has errors.
